result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides. Pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of marked crossings and significant visual obstructions caused by dense on-street parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large vehicles and car covers parked along the curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible on this residential block, forcing pedestrians to cross between parked cars.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to crossing locations.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow street width likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the environment lacks a buffer between pedestrians and traffic, and parked vehicles create visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV and a covered object on the sidewalk block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground along the curbside.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees or planters to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking near intersections to improve visibility for pedestrians crossing the street.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, though the right side is bordered by a long chain-link fence creating a blank frontage. A marked crosswalk and stop sign are visible at the upcoming intersection, but the mid-block area lacks traffic calming and physical buffers between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars along both sides of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially near the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the mid-block section.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long fence on the right side of the street creates a lack of active frontage, which can reduce perceived safety and eyes on the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, extending along the block.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with substandard pedestrian infrastructure. The walkway is narrow, poorly maintained, and lacks a clear buffer from parked vehicles and moving traffic.

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Walkway
hazards.description: The pedestrian path is extremely narrow and encroached upon by parked vehicles and overgrown vegetation, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles block sightlines between pedestrians and any potential moving traffic on this narrow street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the street

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Formalize and widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards, providing a clear, continuous path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
